verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Moses, 'Pharaoh will not listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.modern: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh. The LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart. He did not let the children of Israel go out of His land.

chapters.summary: The LORD told Moses he would bring one final plague on Egypt, after which Pharaoh would drive them out completely; the people were to ask their Egyptian neighbors for silver and gold jewelry. Moses announced to Pharaoh that at midnight the LORD would go through Egypt and every firstborn in the land would die, from Pharaoh's heir to the servant's child, but not a dog would stir against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt,

verses.kjv: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
verses.modern: 'This month shall be for You the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year for You.

verses.kjv: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
verses.modern: Tell all the congregation of Israel that on the tenth day of this month every man shall take a lamb according to their fathers' houses, a lamb for a household.

verses.kjv: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.modern: if the household is too small for a lamb, then He and His nearest neighbor shall take according to the number of persons; according to what each can eat You shall make Your count for the lamb.

verses.kjv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
verses.modern: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats,

verses.kjv: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
verses.modern: you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of this month, when the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill their lambs at twilight.

verses.kjv: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
verses.modern: Then they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and the lintel of the houses in which they eat it.

verses.kjv: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.modern: They shall eat the flesh that night, roasted on the fire; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.

verses.kjv: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
verses.modern: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but roasted, its head with its legs and its inner parts.

verses.kjv: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
verses.modern: you shall let none of it remain until the morning; anything that remains until the morning You shall burn with fire.

verses.kjv: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD's passover.
verses.modern: In this manner You shall eat it: with Your belt fastened, Your sandals on Your feet, and Your staff in Your hand. And You shall eat it in haste. It is the LORD's Passover.

verses.kjv: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.
verses.modern: For I will pass through the land of Egypt that night. I will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast. On all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments. I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: The blood shall be a sign for You, on the houses where You are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over You, and no plague will befall You to destroy You, when I strike the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
verses.modern: This day shall be for You a memorial day, and You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD; throughout Your generations, as a statute forever, You shall keep it as a feast.

verses.kjv: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.modern: Seven days You shall eat unleavened bread. On the first day You shall remove leaven out of Your houses, for if anyone eats what is leavened, from the first day until the seventh day, that person shall be cut off from Israel.

verses.kjv: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
verses.modern: On the first day You shall hold a holy assembly, and on the seventh day a holy assembly. No work shall be done on those days. But what everyone needs to eat, that alone may be prepared by You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
verses.modern: you shall observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread, for on this very day I brought Your hosts out of the land of Egypt. Therefore You shall observe this day throughout Your generations as a statute forever.

verses.kjv: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
verses.modern: In the first month, from the fourteenth day of the month at evening, You shall eat unleavened bread until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.

verses.kjv: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
verses.modern: For seven days no leaven is to be found in Your houses. If anyone eats what is leavened, that person shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether He is a sojourner or a native of the land.

verses.kjv: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
verses.modern: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all Your dwelling places You shall eat unleavened bread.'

verses.kjv: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
verses.modern: Then Moses called all the elders of Israel and said to them, 'Go and select lambs for yourselves according to your clans, and kill the Passover lamb.

verses.kjv: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
verses.modern: Take a bunch of hyssop and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and touch the lintel and the two doorposts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
verses.modern: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians, and when He sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the LORD will pass over the door and will not allow the destroyer to enter Your houses to strike You.

verses.kjv: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
verses.modern: You shall observe this rite as a statute for You and for Your sons forever.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
verses.modern: when You come to the land that the LORD will give You, as He has promised, You shall keep this service.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
verses.modern: when Your children say to You, What do You mean by this service?

verses.kjv: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
verses.modern: you shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD's Passover, for He passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when He struck the Egyptians but spared our houses.' And the people bowed their heads and worshiped.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.modern: Then the children of Israel went and did so; as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.modern: At midnight the LORD struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of the livestock.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
verses.modern: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians. And there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where someone was not dead.

verses.kjv: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
verses.modern: Then He summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said, 'Up, go out from among my people, both You and the children of Israel. Go, serve the LORD, as You have said.

verses.kjv: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
verses.modern: Take Your flocks and Your herds, as You have said, and be gone, and bless me also!'

verses.kjv: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
verses.modern: The Egyptians were urgent with the people to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, 'We shall all be dead.'

verses.kjv: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
verses.modern: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading bowls being bound up in their cloaks on their shoulders.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
verses.modern: The children of Israel had also done as Moses told them, for they had asked the Egyptians for silver and gold jewelry and for clothing.

verses.kjv: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
verses.modern: the LORD had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. Thus they plundered the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
verses.modern: the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.

verses.kjv: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
verses.modern: A mixed crowd also went up with them, and very much livestock, both flocks and herds.

verses.kjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
verses.modern: they baked unleavened cakes of the dough that they had brought out of Egypt, for it was not leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared any provisions for themselves.

verses.kjv: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
verses.modern: The time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was 430 years.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: At the end of 430 years, on that very day, all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
verses.modern: It was a night of watching by the LORD, to bring them out of the land of Egypt; so this same night is a night of watching kept to the LORD by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, 'This is the statute of the Passover: no foreigner shall eat of it,

verses.kjv: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
verses.modern: but every slave that is bought for money may eat of it after You have circumcised Him.

verses.kjv: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
verses.modern: No foreigner or hired servant may eat of it.

verses.kjv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
verses.modern: It shall be eaten in one house; You shall not take any of the flesh outside the house, and You shall not break any of its bones.

verses.kjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.modern: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

verses.kjv: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
verses.modern: If a stranger shall stay with You and would keep the Passover to the LORD, let all His males be circumcised. Then He may come near and keep it; He shall be as a native of the land. But no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

verses.kjv: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
verses.modern: There shall be one law for the native and for the stranger who sojourns among You.'

verses.kjv: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
verses.modern: All the children of Israel did just as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
verses.modern: on that very day the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their hosts.

chapters.summary: The LORD instituted the Passover: each household was to take a lamb without blemish, kill it at twilight, and strike its blood on the doorposts and lintel so that the destroyer would pass over when he struck Egypt's firstborn. At midnight the LORD killed every firstborn in Egypt, from Pharaoh's son to the captive's son, and there was a great cry; Pharaoh urgently sent Israel away that very night. About 600,000 men on foot besides children departed, along with a mixt multitude, taking their unleavened dough and the silver and gold of the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
verses.modern: 'Consecrate to me all the firstborn. Whatever is the first to open the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast, is mine.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
verses.modern: Then Moses said to the people, 'Remember this day in which you came out from Egypt, out of the house of slavery, for by a strong hand the LORD brought You out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.kjv: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
verses.modern: Today, in the month of Abib, You are going out.

verses.kjv: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
verses.modern: when the LORD brings You into the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which He swore to Your fathers to give You, a land flowing with milk and honey, You shall keep this service in this month.

verses.kjv: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
verses.modern: Seven days You shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
verses.modern: Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days; no leavened bread shall be seen with You, and no leaven shall be seen with You in all Your territory.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
verses.modern: You shall tell Your son on that day, It is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
verses.modern: it shall be to You as a sign on Your hand and as a memorial between Your eyes, that the law of the LORD may be in Your mouth. For with a strong hand the LORD has brought You out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
verses.modern: You shall therefore keep this statute at its appointed time from year to year.

verses.kjv: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
verses.modern: When the LORD brings You into the land of the Canaanites, as He swore to You and Your fathers, and shall give it to You,

verses.kjv: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD's.
verses.modern: you shall set apart to the LORD all that first opens the womb. All the firstborn of Your animals that are males shall be the LORD's.

verses.kjv: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
verses.modern: Every firstborn of a donkey You shall redeem with a lamb, or if You will not redeem it You shall break its neck. Every firstborn of man among Your sons You shall redeem.

verses.kjv: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
verses.modern: when in time to come Your son asks You, What does this mean? you shall say to Him, By a strong hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
verses.modern: For when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man and the firstborn of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all the males that first open the womb. But all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.

verses.kjv: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
verses.modern: It shall be as a mark on Your hand and as frontlets between Your eyes, for by a strong hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
verses.modern: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near. For God said, 'Lest the people change their minds when they see war and return to Egypt.'

verses.kjv: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: But God led the people around by the way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea. And the children of Israel went up out of the land of Egypt equipped for battle.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.modern: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the children of Israel solemnly swear, saying, 'God will surely visit you, and you shall carry my bones with you from here.'

verses.kjv: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.modern: they moved on from Succoth and encamped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.modern: the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them along the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.

verses.kjv: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
verses.modern: The pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night did not depart from before the people.

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded that all firstborn be consecrated to him and that Israel keep the feast of unleavened bread as a memorial of the Exodus, teaching it to their children as a sign on their hand and frontlets between their eyes. God did not lead them by the shorter way through the Philistines' land lest the people turn back at the sight of war, but led them through the wilderness toward the Red sea. The LORD went before them by day in a pillar of cloud and by night in a pillar of fire.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
verses.modern: 'Tell the children of Israel to turn back and encamp in front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, in front of Baal-zephon; You shall encamp facing it, by the sea.

verses.kjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
verses.modern: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are wandering in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.

verses.kjv: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.
verses.modern: I will harden Pharaoh's heart. He will pursue them. I will get glory over Pharaoh and all his host, and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.' And they did so.

verses.kjv: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
verses.modern: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, the mind of Pharaoh and his servants was changed toward the people. They said, 'What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?'

verses.kjv: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.modern: So he made ready his chariot and took his army with him,

verses.kjv: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
verses.modern: took 600 chosen chariots and all the other chariots of Egypt with officers over all of them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
verses.modern: the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt. He pursued the children of Israel while the children of Israel were going out defiantly.

verses.kjv: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
verses.modern: The Egyptians pursued them, all Pharaoh's horses and chariots and his horsemen and his army, and overtook them encamped at the sea, by Pi-hahiroth, in front of Baal-zephon.

verses.kjv: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
verses.modern: When Pharaoh drew near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and the Egyptians were marching after them. They feared greatly. And the children of Israel cried out to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.modern: They said to Moses, 'Is it because there are no graves in Egypt that you have taken us away to die in the wilderness? What have you done to us in bringing us out of Egypt?

verses.kjv: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Is not this what we said to you in Egypt, Leave us alone that we may serve the Egyptians? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.modern: Moses said to the people, 'Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the LORD, which He will work for You today. For the Egyptians whom You see today, You shall never see again.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.modern: The LORD will fight for You, and You have only to be silent.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'Why do you cry to me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward.

verses.kjv: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.modern: Lift up Your staff, and stretch out Your hand over the sea and divide it, that the children of Israel may go through the sea on dry ground.

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.modern: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they shall go in after them. I will get glory over Pharaoh and all his host, his chariots and his horsemen.

verses.kjv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.modern: the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten glory over Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

chapters.summary: The whole congregation murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sin, wishing they had died in Egypt where they had bread to eat. Some disobeyed and it bred worms; others went out on the Sabbath and found nothing; Israel ate manna for forty years until they reached Canaan.

chapters.summary: At Rephidim the people quarreled with Moses because there was no water; the LORD told Moses to strike the rock at Horeb with his staff, and water came out. Amalek then attacked Israel, and Joshua led the fight while Moses held up the staff of God on the hilltop — when his hands grew weary, Aaron and Hur held them up until sunset, and Israel prevailed. The LORD declared that he would have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

verses.modern: Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.modern: Now Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, had taken Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her home,

verses.kjv: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.modern: along with her two sons. The name of the one was Gershom (for he said, 'I have been a sojourner in a foreign land'),

verses.kjv: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.modern: the name of the other, Eliezer (for he said, 'The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh').

verses.kjv: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
verses.modern: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness where he was encamped at the mountain of God.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.modern: he sent word to Moses, 'I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons with her.'

verses.kjv: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.modern: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. And they asked each other of their welfare and went into the tent.

verses.kjv: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
verses.modern: Then Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the hardship that had come upon them in the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.

verses.kjv: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.modern: Jethro rejoiced for all the good that the LORD had done to Israel, in that He had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.modern: Jethro said, 'Blessed be the LORD, Who has delivered You out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh and has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
verses.modern: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods, because in this affair they dealt arrogantly with the people.'

verses.kjv: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
verses.modern: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.modern: The next day Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from morning till evening.

verses.kjv: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
verses.modern: When Moses' father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, 'What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone, while all the people stand around you from morning till evening?'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
verses.modern: Moses said to his father-in-law, 'Because the people come to me to inquire of God;

verses.kjv: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
verses.modern: when they have a dispute, they come to me and I decide between one person and another. I make them know the statutes of God and His laws.'

verses.kjv: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
verses.modern: Moses' father-in-law said to him, 'What you are doing is not good.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.modern: You and the people with you will certainly wear yourselves out, for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to do it alone.

verses.kjv: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
verses.modern: Now obey my voice; I will give you advice. God be with you! You shall represent the people before God and bring their cases to God,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.modern: you shall warn them about the statutes and the laws, and make them know the way in which they must walk and what they must do.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.modern: Moreover, look for able men from all the people, men who fear God, men of truth, who hate dishonest gain, and place such men over the people as chiefs of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

verses.kjv: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
verses.modern: let them judge the people at all times. Every great matter they shall bring to you, but any small matter they shall decide themselves. So it will be easier for you. They will bear the burden with you.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.modern: If you do this, God so commanding you, then you will be able to endure. All this people also will go to their place in peace.'

verses.kjv: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.modern: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law and did all that he had said.

verses.kjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.modern: Moses chose able men out of all Israel and made them heads over the people, chiefs of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

verses.kjv: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.modern: they judged the people at all times. Any hard case they brought to Moses, but any small matter they decided themselves.

verses.kjv: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.modern: Then Moses let his father-in-law depart. He went away to his own country.

chapters.summary: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought Zipporah and Moses' two sons to him in the wilderness, rejoiced at all the LORD had done for Israel, and offered sacrifices to God. Seeing Moses judge the people alone from morning to evening, Jethro counseled him to appoint able men as rulers of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens to handle lesser matters. Moses listened to Jethro's advice and set up the system of delegated judges.

verses.kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.modern: On the third new moon after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.modern: They set out from Rephidim and came into the wilderness of Sinai. They encamped in the wilderness. There Israel encamped before the mountain,

verses.kjv: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.modern: while Moses went up to God. The LORD called to Him out of the mountain, saying, 'Thus You shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

verses.kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.modern: You yourselves have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore You on eagles' wings and brought You to myself.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.modern: Now therefore, if You will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, You shall be my treasured possession among all peoples, for all the earth is mine;

verses.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.modern: you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. These are the words that You shall speak to the children of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.modern: So Moses came and called the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded Him.

verses.kjv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.modern: All the people answered together and said, 'All that the LORD has spoken we will do.' And Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, ' I am coming to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe You forever.' When Moses told the words of the people to the LORD,

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments

verses.kjv: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.modern: be ready for the third day. For on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.modern: you shall set limits for the people all around, saying, Take care not to go up into the mountain or touch the edge of it. Whoever touches the mountain shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.modern: No hand shall touch Him, but He shall be stoned or shot; whether beast or man, He shall not live. When the trumpet sounds a long blast, they shall come up to the mountain.'

verses.kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.modern: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people and consecrated the people. They washed their garments.

verses.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.modern: he said to the people, 'Be ready for the third day; do not go near a woman.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.modern: On the morning of the third day there were thunders and lightnings and a thick cloud on the mountain and a very loud trumpet blast, so that all the people in the camp trembled.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.modern: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God. They took their stand at the foot of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.modern: Now Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke because the LORD had descended on it in fire. The smoke of it went up like the smoke of a kiln, and the whole mountain trembled greatly.

verses.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.modern: as the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke. God answered Him in thunder.

verses.kjv: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.modern: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. And the LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Go down and warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to look and many of them perish.

verses.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
verses.modern: Also let the priests who come near to the LORD consecrate themselves, lest the LORD break out against them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.modern: Moses said to the LORD, 'The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, for you yourself warned us, saying, Set limits around the mountain and consecrate it.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Him, 'Go down, and come up bringing Aaron with you. But do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest He break out against them.'

verses.kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.modern: So Moses went down to the people and told them.

chapters.summary: Israel camped before Mount Sinai, and the LORD told Moses that if the people obeyed his voice and kept his covenant they would be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. The people consecrated themselves for three days, washing their clothes and setting bounds around the mountain. On the third day the LORD descended on Sinai in fire with thunder, lightning, a thick cloud, and the sound of a trumpet so loud that the people trembled.

verses.kjv: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.modern: God spoke all these words, saying,

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.modern: 'I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.modern: You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.modern: You shall not make for Yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.modern: You shall not bow down to them or serve them, for I the LORD Your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and the fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.modern: but showing mercy to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.modern: You shall not take the name of the LORD Your God in vain, for the LORD will not hold Him guiltless who takes His name in vain.

verses.kjv: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.modern: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.kjv: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.modern: Six days You shall labor, and do all Your work,

verses.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.modern: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD Your God. On it You shall not do any work, You, or Your son, or Your daughter, Your male servant, or Your female servant, or Your livestock, or the sojourner who is within Your gates.

verses.kjv: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.modern: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested on the seventh day. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.modern: Honor Your father and Your mother, that Your days may be long in the land that the LORD Your God is giving You.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.modern: You shall not kill.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.modern: You shall not commit adultery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.modern: You shall not steal.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.modern: You shall not bear false witness against Your neighbor.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.modern: You shall not covet Your neighbor's house; You shall not covet Your neighbor's wife, or His male servant, or His female servant, or His ox, or his donkey, or anything that is Your neighbor's.'

verses.kjv: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.modern: Now when all the people saw the thunder and the flashes of lightning and the sound of the trumpet and the mountain smoking, the people were afraid and trembled. They stood far off

verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.modern: said to Moses, 'You speak to us. We will listen; but do not let God speak to us, lest we die.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.modern: Moses said to the people, 'Do not fear, for God has come to test you, that the fear of Him may be before you, that you may not sin.'

verses.kjv: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.modern: The people stood far off, while Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: You have seen for yourselves that I have talked with you from heaven.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.modern: You shall not make gods of silver to be with me, nor shall You make for yourselves gods of gold.

verses.kjv: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.modern: An altar of earth You shall make for me and sacrifice on it Your burnt offerings and Your peace offerings, Your sheep and Your oxen. In every place where I cause my name to be remembered I will come to You and bless You.

verses.kjv: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.modern: If You make me an altar of stone, You shall not build it of hewn stones, for if You wield Your tool on it You profane it.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.modern: you shall not go up by steps to my altar, that Your nakedness be not exposed on it.'

chapters.summary: God spoke the Ten Commandments from Mount Sinai: no other gods, no graven images, do not take the LORD's name in vain, keep the Sabbath, honor father and mother, do not kill, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not covet. The people stood far off, trembling at the thunder and fire, and begged Moses to speak to them instead of God. The LORD gave instructions for building altars of earth or uncut stone, forbidding steps that would expose nakedness.

verses.kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.modern: 'Now these are the rules that You shall set before them.

verses.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.modern: When You buy a Hebrew servant, He shall serve six years, and in the seventh He shall go out free, for nothing.

verses.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.modern: If He comes in single, He shall go out single; if He comes in married, then his wife shall go out with Him.

verses.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.modern: If His master gives Him a wife and she bears Him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master's. He shall go out alone.

verses.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.modern: But if the servant plainly says, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free,

verses.kjv: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.modern: then His master shall bring Him to the judges. He shall also bring Him to the door or the doorpost. His master shall pierce His ear through with an awl. He shall serve Him forever.

verses.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.modern: When a man sells his daughter as a slave, she shall not go out as the male slaves do.

verses.kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.modern: If she does not please her master, who has designated her for Himself, then He shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since He has broken faith with her.

verses.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.modern: If He designates her for His son, He shall deal with her as with a daughter.

verses.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.modern: If He takes another wife to Himself, He shall not diminish her food, her clothing, or her marital rights.

verses.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.modern: if He does not do these three things for her, she shall go out for nothing, without payment of money.

verses.kjv: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever strikes a man so that he dies shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.modern: But if He did not lie in wait, but God let Him fall into His hand, then I will appoint for You a place to which He may flee.

verses.kjv: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.modern: But if a man willfully attacks another to kill him by cunning, You shall take Him from my altar, that He may die.

verses.kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever strikes his father or his mother shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever steals a man and sells him, and anyone found in possession of him, shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever curses his father or his mother shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
verses.modern: When men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone or with his fist and the man does not die but takes to his bed,

verses.kjv: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.modern: then if the man rises again and walks outdoors with his staff, he who struck him shall be clear; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall have him thoroughly healed.

verses.kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.modern: When a man strikes his slave, male or female, with a rod and the slave dies under his hand, he shall be avenged.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.modern: But if the slave survives a day or two, he is not to be avenged, for the slave is his money.

verses.kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.modern: When men strive together and hit a pregnant woman, so that her children come out, but there is no harm, the one who hit her shall surely be fined, as the woman's husband shall impose on him. He shall pay as the judges determine.

verses.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.modern: But if there is harm, then you shall pay life for life,

verses.kjv: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.modern: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.kjv: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.modern: burn for burn, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
verses.modern: When a man strikes the eye of his slave, male or female, and destroys it, he shall let the slave go free because of his eye.

verses.kjv: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
verses.modern: If he knocks out the tooth of his slave, male or female, he shall let the slave go free because of his tooth.

verses.kjv: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.modern: When an ox gores a man or a woman to death, the ox shall be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten, but the owner of the ox shall not be liable.

verses.kjv: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.modern: But if the ox has been accustomed to gore in the past, and its owner has been warned but has not kept it in, and it kills a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.modern: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed on him.

verses.kjv: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.modern: If it gores a man's son or daughter, he shall be dealt with according to this same rule.

verses.kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.modern: If the ox gores a slave, male or female, the owner shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.modern: When a man opens a pit, or when a man digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

verses.kjv: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.modern: the owner of the pit shall make restoration. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead beast shall be his.

verses.kjv: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.modern: When one man's ox butts another's, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live ox and share its price, and the dead beast also they shall share.

verses.kjv: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.modern: Or if it is known that the ox has been accustomed to gore in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall repay ox for ox, and the dead beast shall be his.

chapters.summary: The LORD gave laws governing Hebrew servants — including their release in the seventh year and the rights of a maidservant — and laws regarding violence: the penalty for murder, striking or cursing a parent, and kidnapping was death. The principle of "eye for eye, tooth for tooth" governed bodily injuries, and laws addressed injuries caused by an ox that gored a person to death.

verses.kjv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.modern: If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, He shall repay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.kjv: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.modern: If a thief is found breaking in and is struck so that He dies, there shall be no bloodguilt for Him,

verses.kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.modern: but if the sun has risen on Him, there shall be bloodguilt for Him. He shall surely pay. If He has nothing, then He shall be sold for His theft.

verses.kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.modern: If the stolen beast is found alive in His possession, whether it is an ox or a donkey or a sheep, He shall pay double.

verses.kjv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.modern: If a man causes a field or vineyard to be grazed over, or lets His beast loose and it feeds in another man's field, He shall make restitution from the best in His own field and in His own vineyard.

verses.kjv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.modern: If fire breaks out and catches in thorns so that the stacked grain or the standing grain or the field is consumed, He who started the fire shall make full restitution.

verses.kjv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.modern: If a man gives to his neighbor money or goods to keep safe, and it is stolen from the man's house, then, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

verses.kjv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
verses.modern: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house shall come near to the judges to determine whether he has put his hand to his neighbor's property.

verses.kjv: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.modern: For every breach of trust, whether it is for an ox, for a donkey, for a sheep, for a cloak, or for any kind of lost thing, of which one says, This is it, the case of both parties shall come before the judges. The one whom the judges condemn shall pay double to his neighbor.

verses.kjv: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.modern: If a man gives to his neighbor a donkey or an ox or a sheep or any beast to keep safe, and it dies or is injured or is driven away, without anyone seeing it,

verses.kjv: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.modern: an oath by the LORD shall be between them both to see whether or not He has put His hand to His neighbor's property. The owner shall accept the oath. He shall not make restitution.

verses.kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.modern: But if it is stolen from Him, He shall make restitution to its owner.

verses.kjv: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.modern: If it is torn by beasts, let Him bring it as evidence. He shall not make restitution for what has been torn.

verses.kjv: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.modern: If a man borrows anything of his neighbor, and it is injured or dies, the owner not being with it, He shall make full restitution.

verses.kjv: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.modern: If the owner was with it, He shall not make restitution; if it was hired, it came for its hiring fee.

verses.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.modern: If a man seduces a virgin who is not betrothed and lies with her, He shall give the bride price for her and make her his wife.

verses.kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.modern: If her father utterly refuses to give her to Him, He shall pay money equal to the bride price for virgins.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.modern: You shall not permit a sorceress to live.

verses.kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Whoever lies with an animal shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.modern: Whoever sacrifices to any god, other than the LORD alone, shall be devoted to destruction.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: You shall not wrong a sojourner or oppress Him, for You were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.modern: You shall not mistreat any widow or fatherless child.

verses.kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.modern: If You do mistreat them, and they cry out to me, I will surely hear their cry,

verses.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.modern: my wrath will burn. I will kill You with the sword, and Your wives shall become widows and Your children fatherless.

verses.kjv: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.modern: If You lend money to any of my people with You who is poor, You shall not be like a moneylender to Him, and You shall not exact interest from Him.

verses.kjv: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.modern: If ever You take Your neighbor's cloak in pledge, You shall return it to Him before the sun goes down,

verses.kjv: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.modern: for that is His only covering. It is His cloak for His body; in what else shall He sleep? And if He cries to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.modern: You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of Your people.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.modern: You shall not delay to offer from the fullness of Your harvest and from the outflow of Your presses. The firstborn of Your sons You shall give to me.

verses.kjv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.modern: You shall do the same with Your oxen and with Your sheep: seven days it shall be with its mother; on the eighth day You shall give it to me.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.modern: You shall be consecrated to me. Therefore You shall not eat any flesh that is torn by beasts in the field; You shall throw it to the dogs.

chapters.summary: Laws governing theft, property damage, and restitution are given, including penalties for stealing livestock, damage by fire, and breach of trust over goods left in safekeeping. Laws regarding sexual sin, sorcery, idolatry, and the treatment of strangers, widows, and orphans are established. Commands are given against lending at interest to the poor, against reviling God or rulers, and requiring firstfruits and firstborn to be given to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.modern: You shall not spread a false report. You shall not join hands with a wicked man to be a malicious witness.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.modern: You shall not fall in with the many to do evil, nor shall You bear witness in a lawsuit, siding with the many, so as to pervert justice,

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.modern: nor shall You be partial to a poor man in His lawsuit.

verses.kjv: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.modern: If You meet Your enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, You shall bring it back to Him.

verses.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.modern: If You see the donkey of one who hates You lying down under its burden, You shall refrain from leaving Him with it; You shall rescue it with Him.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.modern: You shall not pervert the justice due to Your poor in His lawsuit.

verses.kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.modern: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent and righteous, for I will not acquit the wicked.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.modern: you shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: You shall not oppress a sojourner. You know the heart of a sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.modern: For six years you shall sow your land and gather in its yield,

verses.kjv: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.modern: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat. What they leave the beasts of the field may eat. You shall do likewise with your vineyard, and with your olive orchard.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.modern: Six days you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant woman, and the sojourner, may be refreshed.

verses.kjv: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.modern: Pay attention to all that I have said to you, and make no mention of the names of other gods, nor let it be heard on your lips.

verses.kjv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.modern: Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.modern: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. As I commanded you, you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. None shall appear before me empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.modern: You shall keep the Feast of Harvest, of the firstfruits of your labor, of what you sow in the field. You shall keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in from the field the fruit of your labor.

verses.kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.modern: Three times in the year shall all Your males appear before the Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.modern: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the fat of my feast remain until the morning.

verses.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
