verses.modern: The best of the firstfruits of Your ground You shall bring into the house of the LORD Your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

verses.kjv: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.modern: I send an angel before You to guard You on the way and to bring You to the place that I have prepared.

verses.kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.modern: Pay careful attention to Him and obey His voice; do not rebel against Him, for He will not pardon Your transgression, for my name is in Him.

verses.kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.modern: But if You carefully obey His voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to Your enemies and an adversary to Your adversaries.

verses.kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.modern: When my angel goes before You and brings You to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, and I will cut them off,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.modern: you shall not bow down to their gods nor serve them, nor do as they do, but You shall utterly overthrow them and break their pillars in pieces.

verses.kjv: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.modern: You shall serve the LORD Your God. He will bless Your bread and Your water. I will take sickness away from among You.

verses.kjv: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.modern: None shall miscarry or be barren in Your land; I will fulfill the number of Your days.

verses.kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.modern: I will send my terror before You and will throw into confusion all the people against whom you shall come. I will make all Your enemies turn their backs to You.

verses.kjv: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.modern: I will send hornets before You, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before You.

verses.kjv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.modern: I will not drive them out from before You in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against You.

verses.kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.modern: Little by little I will drive them out from before You, until You have increased and possess the land.

verses.kjv: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.modern: I will set Your border from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates, for I will give the inhabitants of the land into Your hand, and You shall drive them out before You.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.modern: You shall make no covenant with them and their gods.

verses.kjv: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.modern: They shall not dwell in Your land, lest they make You sin against me; for if You serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to You.'

chapters.summary: Laws of justice are given: do not follow a crowd to do evil, do not show partiality to the poor in court, return your enemy's stray animal, and let the land rest every seventh year. The three annual feasts are commanded — Unleavened Bread, Harvest, and Ingathering — and the people are forbidden to boil a kid in its mother's milk. The LORD promised to send an angel before them to drive out the Canaanites, warning Israel not to worship their gods or make covenants with them.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.modern: Then He said to Moses, 'Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.

verses.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.modern: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but the others shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with him.'

verses.kjv: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
verses.modern: Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD and all the rules. And all the people answered with one voice and said, 'All the words that the LORD has spoken we will do.'

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. He rose early in the morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
verses.modern: he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.modern: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he threw against the altar.

verses.kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.modern: Then He took the Book of the Covenant and read it in the hearing of the people. And they said, 'All that the LORD has spoken we will do. We will be obedient.'

verses.kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.modern: Moses took the blood and threw it on the people and said, ' the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with You in accordance with all these words.'

verses.kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.modern: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,

verses.kjv: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.modern: they saw the God of Israel. There was under His feet as it were a pavement of sapphire stone, like the very heaven for clearness.

verses.kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.modern: he did not lay his hand on the chief men of the children of Israel; they beheld God, and ate and drank.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'Come up to me on the mountain and wait there, that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction.'

verses.kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.modern: So Moses rose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God.

verses.kjv: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.modern: he said to the elders, 'Wait here for us until we return to you. And Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever has a dispute, let him go to them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.modern: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.modern: The glory of the LORD lived on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day He called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

verses.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Now the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the sight of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.modern: Moses entered the cloud and went up on the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

chapters.summary: Moses read the book of the covenant to the people and they answered "All that the LORD has said we will do, and be obedient"; he sprinkled blood on them to ratify the covenant. Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders went up and saw the God of Israel with a pavement of sapphire under his feet, and they ate and drank. The LORD called Moses up into the mountain, where he stayed forty days and forty nights to receive the tables of stone.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.modern: 'Speak to the children of Israel, that they take for me a contribution. From every man whose heart moves him you shall receive the contribution for me.

verses.kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.modern: this is the contribution that You shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.modern: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine linen and goats' hair,

verses.kjv: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.modern: tanned rams' skins, goatskins, acacia wood,

verses.kjv: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.modern: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,

verses.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.modern: onyx stones, and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.modern: let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst.

verses.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.modern: Exactly as I show You concerning the pattern of the tabernacle, and of all its furniture, so You shall make it.

verses.kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.modern: They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.modern: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside shall You overlay it, and You shall make on it a molding of gold around it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.modern: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.modern: You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.modern: you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark by them.

verses.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.modern: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.modern: you shall put into the ark the testimony that I shall give You.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.modern: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.modern: you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work shall You make them, on the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.modern: Make one cherub on the one end, and one cherub on the other end. Of one piece with the mercy seat shall You make the cherubim on its two ends.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.modern: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.modern: you shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark, and in the ark You shall put the testimony that I shall give You.

verses.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.modern: There I will meet with You, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of the testimony, I will speak with You about all that I will give You in commandment for the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.modern: You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.modern: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a molding of gold around it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.modern: you shall make a rim around it a handbreadth wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.modern: you shall make for it four rings of gold, and fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.

verses.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.modern: Close to the frame the rings shall lie, as holders for the poles to carry the table.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.modern: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with these.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.modern: you shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; You shall make them of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.modern: you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me regularly.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.modern: You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of hammered work: its base, its stem, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

verses.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.modern: there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;

verses.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.modern: three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on the other branch — so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.

verses.kjv: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.modern: on the lampstand itself there shall be four cups made like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and flowers,

verses.kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.modern: a calyx of one piece with it under each pair of the six branches going out from the lampstand.

verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.modern: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it a single piece of hammered work of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.modern: You shall make seven lamps for it. And the lamps shall be set up so as to give light on the space in front of it.

verses.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.modern: Its tongs and their trays shall be of pure gold.

verses.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.modern: It shall be made, with all these utensils, out of a talent of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.modern: see that You make them after the pattern for them, which is being shown You on the mountain.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Israel to bring a freewill offering of gold, silver, bronze, fine fabrics, skins, wood, oil, spices, and precious stones to build a sanctuary that he might dwell among them. Detailed instructions are given for the ark of the covenant — overlaid with gold, with a mercy seat and two cherubim — the table of showbread, and the seven-branched golden lampstand, all to be made according to the pattern shown on the mountain.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.modern: 'Moreover, you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns; you shall make them with cherubim skillfully worked into them.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.modern: The length of each curtain shall be 28 cubits, and the breadth of each curtain 4 cubits; all the curtains shall be the same size.

verses.kjv: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.modern: Five curtains shall be coupled to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.modern: you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set. Likewise you shall make them on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

verses.kjv: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.modern: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.modern: you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to the other with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be a single whole.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.modern: You shall also make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains shall you make.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.modern: The length of each curtain shall be 30 cubits, and the breadth of each curtain 4 cubits. The eleven curtains shall be the same size.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and the sixth curtain you shall double over at the front of the tent.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.modern: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.modern: you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together that it may be a single whole.

verses.kjv: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: the part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.modern: the extra that remains in the length of the curtains, the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and that side, to cover it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
verses.modern: you shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins and a covering of goatskins on top.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.modern: You shall make upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.

verses.kjv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.modern: Ten cubits shall be the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each frame.

verses.kjv: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: There shall be two tenons in each frame, for fitting together. So shall you do for all the frames of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.modern: You shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side;

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.modern: forty bases of silver you shall make under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons;

verses.kjv: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.modern: for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side twenty frames,

verses.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.modern: their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame, and two bases under the next frame.

verses.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.modern: for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six frames.

verses.kjv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.modern: you shall make two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear;

verses.kjv: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.modern: they shall be separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring. Thus shall it be with both of them; they shall form the two corners.

verses.kjv: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.modern: there shall be eight frames, with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one frame, and two bases under another frame.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.modern: You shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.modern: five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.

verses.kjv: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.modern: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall run from end to end.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.modern: You shall overlay the frames with gold and shall make their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.modern: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.modern: you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen. It shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.modern: you shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, with hooks of gold, on four bases of silver.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.modern: you shall hang the veil from the clasps, and bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil. And the veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.modern: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.modern: you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle opposite the table, and you shall put the table on the north side.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.modern: You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.modern: you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.

chapters.summary: Instructions are given for the tabernacle's curtains: ten inner curtains of fine linen with blue, purple, and scarlet, joined by loops and clasps, and eleven curtains of goat hair for the tent covering above. The framework of the tabernacle is described — boards of acacia wood overlaid with gold set in silver sockets — along with the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet separating the holy place from the most holy place.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.modern: You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits broad. The altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.modern: you shall make horns for it on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.modern: You shall make pots for it to receive its ashes, and shovels and basins and forks and fire pans. You shall make all its utensils of bronze.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.modern: You shall also make for it a grating, a network of bronze, and on the net you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.modern: you shall set it under the ledge of the altar so that the net extends halfway down the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.modern: you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

verses.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.modern: the poles shall be put through the rings, so that the poles are on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

verses.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.modern: You shall make it hollow, with boards. As it has been shown you on the mountain, so shall it be made.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.modern: You shall make the court of the tabernacle. On the south side the court shall have hangings of fine twined linen a hundred cubits long for one side.

verses.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.modern: Its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.modern: likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, its pillars twenty and their bases twenty, of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.modern: for the breadth of the court on the west side there shall be hangings for fifty cubits, with ten pillars and ten bases.

verses.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.modern: The breadth of the court on the front to the east shall be fifty cubits.

verses.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.modern: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.

verses.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.modern: On the other side the hangings shall be fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.

verses.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.modern: For the gate of the court there shall be a screen twenty cubits long, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework. It shall have four pillars and with them four bases.

verses.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.modern: All the pillars around the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their bases of bronze.

verses.kjv: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.modern: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, the breadth fifty, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twined linen and bases of bronze.

verses.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.modern: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, shall be of bronze.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.modern: You shall command the children of Israel that they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, that a lamp may regularly be set up to burn.

verses.kjv: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening to morning before the LORD. It shall be a statute forever to be observed throughout their generations by the children of Israel.

chapters.summary: Instructions are given for the bronze altar of burnt offering, five cubits square and three cubits high, with horns at its four corners, and all its utensils of bronze. The court of the tabernacle is described: hangings of fine linen supported by pillars with silver hooks and bronze sockets, one hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide. The people are commanded to bring pure beaten olive oil for the lamp to burn continually in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
verses.modern: Then bring near to you Aaron your brother and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, to serve me as priests — Aaron and Aaron's sons, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.modern: you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: You shall speak to all the skillful, whom I have filled with a spirit of skill, that they make Aaron's garments to consecrate him for my priesthood.

verses.kjv: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a coat of checker work, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons to serve me as priests.

verses.kjv: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.modern: They shall receive gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.modern: they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and of fine twined linen, skillfully worked.

verses.kjv: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
verses.modern: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached to its two edges, so that it may be joined together.

verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.modern: the skillfully woven band on it shall be made like it and be of one piece with it, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.modern: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,

verses.kjv: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.modern: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

verses.kjv: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.modern: As a jeweler engraves signets, so shall you engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel. You shall enclose them in settings of gold filigree.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.modern: you shall set the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on His two shoulders for remembrance.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
verses.modern: You shall make settings of gold filigree,

verses.kjv: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.modern: two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords. You shall attach the corded chains to the settings.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.modern: You shall make a breastpiece of judgment, in skilled work. In the style of the ephod You shall make it — of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen shall You make it.

verses.kjv: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
verses.modern: It shall be square and doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
verses.modern: You shall set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle shall be the first row;

verses.kjv: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.modern: the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;

verses.kjv: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.modern: the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.kjv: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.modern: the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be set in gold filigree.

verses.kjv: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.modern: There shall be twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel. They shall be like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.modern: You shall make for the breastpiece twisted chains like cords, of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.modern: you shall make for the breastpiece two rings of gold, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.modern: you shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.modern: The two ends of the two cords You shall attach to the two settings of filigree, and so attach it in front to the shoulder pieces of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.modern: You shall make two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.

verses.kjv: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.modern: you shall make two rings of gold, and attach them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its seam above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.modern: they shall bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it may lie on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, so that the breastpiece shall not come loose from the ephod.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
verses.modern: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment on His heart, when He goes into the Holy Place, to bring them to regular remembrance before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
verses.modern: in the breastpiece of judgment You shall put the Urim and the Thummim. They shall be on Aaron's heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Thus Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on His heart before the LORD regularly.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.modern: You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.kjv: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
verses.modern: It shall have an opening for the head in the middle of it, with a woven binding around the opening, like the opening in a garment, so that it may not tear.

verses.kjv: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.modern: On its hem You shall make pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, around its hem, with bells of gold between them,

verses.kjv: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.modern: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.modern: it shall be on Aaron when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when He goes into the Holy Place before the LORD, and when He comes out, so that He does not die.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.modern: You shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, Holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.modern: you shall fasten it on the turban by a cord of blue. It shall be on the front of the turban.

verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.modern: It shall be on Aaron's forehead, and Aaron shall bear any guilt from the holy things that the children of Israel consecrate as their holy gifts. It shall regularly be on His forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
verses.modern: You shall weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and You shall make a turban of fine linen, and You shall make a sash embroidered with needlework.

verses.kjv: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.modern: For Aaron's sons you shall make coats and sashes and caps. You shall make them for glory and beauty.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: you shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them and ordain them and consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
verses.modern: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the hips to the thighs;

verses.kjv: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
verses.modern: they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they go into the tent of meeting or when they come near the altar to minister in the Holy Place, lest they bear guilt and die. This shall be a statute forever for him and for his seed after him.

chapters.summary: Instructions are given for the holy garments of Aaron the high priest: the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet with two onyx shoulder stones engraved with the names of the twelve tribes. The breastplate of judgment, set with twelve precious stones bearing the tribes' names, is described along with the Urim and Thummim. The robe of the ephod, the golden plate inscribed "HOLINESS TO THE LORD" for the mitre, and the linen garments for Aaron's sons are specified.

verses.kjv: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.modern: 'Now this is what You shall do to them to consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests. Take one bull of the herd and two rams without blemish,

verses.kjv: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.modern: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers smeared with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.modern: You shall put them in one basket and bring them in the basket, and bring the bull and the two rams.

verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.modern: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.modern: Then you shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the coat and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastpiece, and gird him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.modern: you shall set the turban on his head and put the holy crown on the turban.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.modern: You shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.modern: Then you shall bring his sons and put coats on them,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.modern: you shall gird Aaron and his sons with sashes and bind caps on them. And the priesthood shall be theirs by a statute forever. Thus you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.modern: Then you shall bring the bull before the tent of meeting. Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Then You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the entrance of the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.modern: shall take part of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with Your finger, and the rest of the blood You shall pour out at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
verses.modern: you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

verses.kjv: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
verses.modern: But the flesh of the bull and its skin and its dung You shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.modern: Then you shall take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
verses.modern: you shall slaughter the ram and shall take its blood and throw it against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
verses.modern: Then you shall cut the ram into pieces, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its pieces and its head,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: burn the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the LORD. It is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.modern: You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.modern: you shall kill the ram and take part of its blood and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron and on the tips of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet, and throw the rest of the blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.modern: Then you shall take part of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and his sons' garments with him. He and his garments shall be holy, and his sons and his sons' garments with him.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.modern: You shall also take the fat from the ram and the fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails, and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ordination),

verses.kjv: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
verses.modern: one loaf of bread and one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.modern: You shall put all these on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Then You shall take them from their hands and burn them on the altar on top of the burnt offering, as a sweet savour before the LORD. It is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
verses.modern: You shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron's ordination and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be Your portion.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.modern: you shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the priests' portion that is contributed from the ram of ordination, from what was Aaron's and his sons'.

verses.kjv: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as a perpetual due from the children of Israel, for it is a contribution. It shall be a contribution from the children of Israel from their peace offerings, their contribution to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.modern: The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him; they shall be anointed in them and ordained in them.

verses.kjv: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
verses.modern: The son who succeeds him as priest, who comes into the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place, shall wear them seven days.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.modern: You shall take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.

verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket in the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.modern: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made at their ordination and consecration, but an outsider shall not eat of them, because they are holy.

verses.kjv: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.modern: if any of the flesh for the ordination, or of the bread, remain until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.modern: Thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. Through seven days shall you ordain them,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.modern: every day you shall offer a bull as a sin offering for atonement. Also you shall purify the altar, when you make atonement for it, and shall anoint it to consecrate it.

verses.kjv: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.modern: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it, and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall become holy.

verses.kjv: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.modern: Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day regularly.

verses.kjv: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.modern: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight.

verses.kjv: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.modern: with the first lamb a tenth measure of fine flour mingled with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

verses.kjv: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.modern: The other lamb You shall offer at twilight, and shall offer with it a grain offering and its drink offering, as in the morning, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

verses.kjv: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.modern: It shall be a regular burnt offering throughout Your generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with You, to speak to You there.

verses.kjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.modern: There I will meet with the children of Israel. It shall be sanctified by my glory.

verses.kjv: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar. Aaron also and his sons I will consecrate to serve me as priests.

verses.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.modern: I will dwell among the children of Israel and will be their God.

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
verses.modern: they shall know that I am the LORD their God, Who brought them out of the land of Egypt that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.'

chapters.summary: The consecration ceremony for Aaron and his sons is described: they are to be washed, clothed in the priestly garments, and anointed; a bull is offered as a sin offering and two rams as a burnt offering and ordination offering over seven days. The LORD commands a continual burnt offering of two lambs daily, one in the morning and one at evening, at the door of the tent of meeting. God promises to sanctify the tabernacle and dwell among the children of Israel and be their God.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.modern: You shall make an altar on which to burn incense; You shall make it of acacia wood.

verses.kjv: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
verses.modern: A cubit shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth. It shall be square, and two cubits shall be its height. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.modern: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and around its sides and its horns. And You shall make a molding of gold around it.

verses.kjv: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.modern: you shall make two golden rings for it. Under its molding on two opposite sides of it You shall make them. They shall be holders for poles with which to carry it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.modern: You shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.modern: you shall put it in front of the veil that is above the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy seat that is above the testimony, where I will meet with You.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.modern: Aaron shall burn fragrant incense on it. Every morning when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn it,

verses.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
verses.modern: when Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he shall burn it, a regular incense offering before the LORD throughout Your generations.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
verses.modern: You shall not offer unauthorized incense on it, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering, and You shall not pour a drink offering on it.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once a year. With the blood of the sin offering of atonement He shall make atonement for it once in the year throughout Your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
verses.modern: 'When You take the census of the children of Israel, then each shall give a ransom for His life to the LORD when You number them, that there be no plague among them when You number them.

verses.kjv: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
verses.modern: Each one who is numbered in the census shall give this: half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: Everyone who is numbered in the census, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the LORD's offering.

verses.kjv: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.modern: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when You give the LORD's offering to make atonement for Your lives.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be for a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.modern: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel and shall give it for the service of the tent of meeting, that it may bring the children of Israel to remembrance before the LORD, so as to make atonement for Your lives.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.modern: 'You shall also make a basin of bronze, with its stand of bronze, for washing. You shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and You shall put water in it,

verses.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.modern: with which Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet.

verses.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
verses.modern: When they go into the tent of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister, to burn a offering made by fire to the LORD, they shall wash with water, so that they may not die.

verses.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.modern: They shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they may not die. It shall be a statute forever to them, even to Him and to His seed throughout their generations.'

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
verses.modern: 'Take the finest spices: of liquid myrrh 500 shekels, and of sweet-smelling cinnamon half as much, that is, 250, and 250 of aromatic cane,

verses.kjv: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.modern: 500 of cassia, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
verses.modern: you shall make of these a sacred anointing oil blended as by the perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.modern: With it You shall anoint the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony,

verses.kjv: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.modern: the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

verses.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.modern: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils and the basin and its stand.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.modern: You shall consecrate them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them will become holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.modern: you shall say to the children of Israel, This shall be my holy anointing oil throughout your generations.

verses.kjv: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
verses.modern: It shall not be poured on the body of an ordinary person, and you shall make no other like it in composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

verses.kjv: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'Take sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, sweet spices with pure frankincense (of each shall there be an equal part),

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
verses.modern: make an incense blended as by the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.modern: You shall beat some of it very small, and put part of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting where I shall meet with You. It shall be most holy for You.

verses.kjv: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
verses.modern: the incense that You shall make according to its composition, You shall not make for yourselves. It shall be for You holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto it, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.modern: Whoever makes any like it to use as perfume shall be cut off from His people.'

chapters.summary: Instructions are given for the golden altar of incense, placed before the veil, where Aaron burns fragrant incense each morning and evening. The LORD commands a half-shekel atonement tax from every man numbered in the census, and describes the bronze basin for washing, the holy anointing oil of myrrh, cinnamon, calamus, cassia, and olive oil, and the sacred incense — all forbidden for common use on pain of being cut off from the people.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.modern: 'See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
