verses.kjv: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.modern: I have filled Him with the Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence, with knowledge and all craftsmanship,

verses.kjv: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.modern: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.modern: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, to work in every craft.

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.modern: I have appointed with Him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And I have given to all able men ability, that they may make all that I have commanded You:

verses.kjv: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
verses.modern: the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is on it. All the furnishings of the tent,

verses.kjv: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.modern: the table and its utensils, and the pure lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,

verses.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
verses.modern: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin and its stand,

verses.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
verses.modern: the finely worked garments, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, for their service as priests,

verses.kjv: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.modern: the anointing oil and the fragrant incense for the Holy Place. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
verses.modern: 'You are to speak to the children of Israel and say, Above all You shall keep my Sabbaths, for this is a sign between me and You throughout Your generations, that You may know that I, the LORD, sanctify You.

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.modern: You shall keep the Sabbath, because it is holy for You. Everyone who profanes it shall be put to death. Whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among His people.

verses.kjv: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.modern: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.modern: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, observing the Sabbath throughout their generations, as a covenant forever.

verses.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.modern: It is a sign forever between me and the children of Israel that in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.'

verses.kjv: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.modern: he gave to Moses, when he had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.

chapters.summary: The LORD named Bezaleel of the tribe of Judah and Aholiab of the tribe of Dan as the master craftsmen for building the tabernacle, filling them with the Spirit of God in wisdom, understanding, and skill. The LORD restated the command to keep the Sabbath as a perpetual sign between himself and Israel, declaring that whoever works on it shall be put to death. When he finished speaking with Moses on Sinai, God gave him the two tables of testimony, written with the finger of God.

verses.kjv: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.modern: When the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron and said to him, 'Up, make us gods who shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.'

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
verses.modern: So Aaron said to them, 'Take off the rings of gold that are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.'

verses.kjv: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.modern: So all the people took off the rings of gold that were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.

verses.kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: he received the gold from their hand and fashioned it with a graving tool and made a golden calf. And they said, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!'

verses.kjv: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
verses.modern: When Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it. And Aaron made a proclamation and said, 'Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.modern: they rose up early the next day and offered burnt offerings and brought peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink and rose up to play.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Go down, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.

verses.kjv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: They have turned aside quickly out of the way that I commanded them. They have made for themselves a golden calf and have worshiped it and sacrificed to it and said, These are Your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'I have seen this people. It is a stiff-necked people.

verses.kjv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.modern: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them, in order that I may make a great nation of You.'

verses.kjv: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.modern: But Moses implored the LORD His God and said, 'O LORD, why does Your wrath burn hot against Your people, whom You have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.modern: Why should the Egyptians say, With evil intent did He bring them out, to kill them in the mountains and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from Your burning anger and relent from this disaster against Your people.

verses.kjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.modern: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have promised I will give to your seed, and they shall inherit it forever.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.modern: the LORD relented from the disaster that He had spoken of bringing on His people.

verses.kjv: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.modern: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand, tablets that were written on both sides; on the front and on the back they were written.

verses.kjv: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.modern: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

verses.kjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.modern: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, 'There is a noise of war in the camp.'

verses.kjv: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.modern: But he said, 'It is not the sound of shouting for victory, or the sound of the cry of defeat, but the sound of singing that I hear.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.modern: as soon as he came near the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, Moses' anger burned hot. He threw the tablets out of his hands and broke them at the foot of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.modern: He took the calf that they had made and burned it with fire and ground it to powder and scattered it on the water and made the children of Israel drink it.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.modern: Moses said to Aaron, 'What did this people do to you that you have brought such a great sin upon them?'

verses.kjv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.modern: Aaron said, 'Let not the anger of my lord burn hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

verses.kjv: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.modern: For they said to me, Make us gods who shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.modern: So I said to them, Let any who have gold take it off. So they gave it to me. I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.'

verses.kjv: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.modern: when Moses saw that the people had broken loose (for Aaron had let them break loose, to the derision of their enemies),

verses.kjv: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.modern: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, 'Who is on the LORD's side? Come to me.' And all the sons of Levi gathered around Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.modern: he said to them, 'Thus says the LORD God of Israel, Put Your sword on Your side each of You, and go to and fro from gate to gate throughout the camp, and each of You kill His brother and His companion and His neighbor.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.modern: the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. And that day about three thousand men of the people fell.

verses.kjv: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.modern: Moses said, 'Today you have been ordained for the service of the LORD, each one at the cost of his son and of his brother, so that He might bestow a blessing upon You this day.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.modern: The next day Moses said to the people, 'You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for Your sin.'

verses.kjv: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.modern: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, 'Alas, this people has sinned a great sin. They have made for themselves gods of gold.

verses.kjv: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.modern: But now, if You will forgive their sin — but if not, please blot me out of Your book that You have written.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.modern: But the LORD said to Moses, 'Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot out of my book.

verses.kjv: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.modern: But now go, lead the people to the place about which I have spoken to You; my angel shall go before You. Nevertheless, in the day when I visit, I will visit their sin upon them.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.modern: Then the LORD sent a plague on the people, because they made the calf, the one that Aaron made.

chapters.summary: When Moses delayed on the mountain, the people demanded Aaron make them gods; Aaron collected their gold earrings and fashioned a golden calf, and the people sacrificed to it and rose up to play. The LORD told Moses to go down, and Moses pleaded for the people; descending and seeing the calf and the dancing, he shattered the two tablets in anger. Moses ground the calf to powder, scattered it on the water, and made the people drink it; the sons of Levi killed about three thousand men that day, and the LORD sent a plague upon the people.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'Depart; go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed I will give it.

verses.kjv: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.modern: I will send an angel before You. I will drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.kjv: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.modern: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among You, lest I consume You on the way, for You are a stiff-necked people.'

verses.kjv: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.modern: When the people heard this disastrous word, they mourned, and no one put on his ornaments.

verses.kjv: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.modern: For the LORD had said to Moses, 'Say to the children of Israel, you are a stiff-necked people; if for a single moment I should go up among You, I would consume You. So now take off Your ornaments, that I may know what to do with You.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.modern: Therefore the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments, from Mount Horeb onward.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.modern: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far off from the camp. He called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought the LORD would go out to the tent of meeting, which was outside the camp.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.modern: Whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise up, and each would stand at his tent door, and watch Moses until he had gone into the tent.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
verses.modern: When Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance of the tent. The LORD would speak with Moses.

verses.kjv: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.modern: when all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would rise up and worship, each at his tent door.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: Thus the LORD used to speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. When Moses turned again into the camp, his assistant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.modern: Moses said to the LORD, 'See, You say to me, Bring up this people, but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, I know You by name, and You have also found favor in my sight.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.modern: Now therefore, if I have found favor in Your sight, please show me now Your ways, that I may know You in order to find favor in Your sight. Consider too that this nation is Your people.'

verses.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.modern: he said, 'My presence will go with You. I will give You rest.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.modern: he said to Him, 'If Your presence will not go with me, do not bring us up from here.

verses.kjv: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.modern: For how shall it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not in Your going with us, so that we are distinct, I and Your people, from every other people on the face of the earth?'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'This very thing that you have spoken I will do, for you have found favor in my sight. I know you by name.'

verses.kjv: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.modern: Moses said, 'Please show me your glory.'

verses.kjv: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.modern: he said, 'I will make all my goodness pass before You and will proclaim before You my name, The LORD. And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.modern: But,' he said, 'you cannot see my face, for man shall not see me and live.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.modern: the LORD said, ' there is a place by me where You shall stand on the rock,

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.modern: while my glory passes by I will put You in a cleft of the rock. I will cover You with my hand until I have passed by.

verses.kjv: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.modern: Then I will take away my hand, and You shall see my back, but my face shall not be seen.'

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Israel to depart for the Promised Land but said he would not go up in their midst lest he consume them, for they were a stiff-necked people; the people mourned and stripped off their ornaments. Moses pitched the tent of meeting outside the camp, and the pillar of cloud descended when he entered; the LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Moses asked to see God's glory, and the LORD agreed to pass by and proclaim his name, but said no man could see his face and live, placing Moses in the cleft of a rock and covering him with his hand.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which You broke.

verses.kjv: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.modern: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present Yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.modern: No one shall come up with you, and let no one be seen throughout all the mountain. Let no flocks or herds graze opposite that mountain.'

verses.kjv: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.modern: So Moses cut two tablets of stone like the first. And He rose early in the morning and went up on Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded Him, and took in His hand two tablets of stone.

verses.kjv: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: The LORD descended in the cloud and stood with Him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.modern: The LORD passed before Him and proclaimed, 'The LORD, the LORD, a God merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and of great mercy and truth,

verses.kjv: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.modern: keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, but who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and the children's children, to the third and the fourth generation.'

verses.kjv: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.modern: Moses quickly bowed his head toward the earth and worshiped.

verses.kjv: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.modern: he said, 'If now I have found favor in your sight, O Lord, please let the Lord go in the midst of us, for it is a stiff-necked people, and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
verses.modern: he said, ' I am making a covenant. Before all Your people I will do marvels, such as have not been created in all the earth or in any nation. And all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the LORD, for it is an awesome thing that I will do with You.

verses.kjv: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.modern: Observe what I command You this day. I will drive out before You the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.kjv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.modern: Take care, lest You make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which You go, lest it become a snare in Your midst.

verses.kjv: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
verses.modern: You shall tear down their altars and break their pillars and cut down their groves

verses.kjv: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
verses.modern: (for You shall worship no other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God),

verses.kjv: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.modern: lest You make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and when they whore after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and You are invited, You eat of His sacrifice,

verses.kjv: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.modern: you take of their daughters for Your sons. Their daughters whore after their gods and make Your sons whore after their gods.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.modern: You shall not make for Yourself any gods of cast metal.

verses.kjv: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.modern: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. Seven days You shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded You, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in the month of Abib You came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.modern: All that open the womb are mine, all Your male livestock, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

verses.kjv: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.modern: The firstborn of a donkey You shall redeem with a lamb, or if You will not redeem it You shall break its neck. All the firstborn of Your sons You shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty-handed.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.modern: Six days You shall work, but on the seventh day You shall rest. In plowing time and in harvest You shall rest.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
verses.modern: You shall observe the Feast of Weeks, the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the year's end.

verses.kjv: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
verses.modern: Three times in the year shall all Your males appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
verses.modern: For I will cast out nations before You and enlarge Your borders; no one shall covet your land when you go up to appear before the LORD Your God three times in the year.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.modern: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover remain until the morning.

verses.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
verses.modern: The best of the firstfruits of Your ground You shall bring to the house of the LORD Your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Moses, 'Write these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.'

verses.kjv: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.modern: So He was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights. He neither ate bread nor drank water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.modern: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand as he came down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God.

verses.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.modern: Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and the skin of his face shone. They were afraid to come near him.

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.modern: But Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses talked with them.

verses.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.modern: Afterward all the children of Israel came near. He commanded them all that the LORD had spoken with Him in Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.modern: when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

verses.kjv: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.modern: Whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, He would remove the veil, until He came out. And when He came out and told the children of Israel what He was commanded,

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.modern: the children of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face was shining. And Moses would put the veil over his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

chapters.summary: The LORD told Moses to cut two new tablets of stone and come up to Sinai alone; the LORD descended in a cloud and proclaimed his name: "The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth." God renewed the covenant, warning against idolatry and intermarriage with the Canaanites, and restating the feasts and the Sabbath. Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights without food or water; when he came down, the skin of his face shone so brightly that the people were afraid to come near him, and he put a veil over his face.

verses.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.modern: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel and said to them, 'These are the things that the LORD has commanded You to do.

verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.modern: Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day You shall have a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.

verses.kjv: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.modern: You shall kindle no fire in all Your dwelling places on the Sabbath day.'

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.modern: Moses said to all the congregation of the children of Israel, 'This is the thing that the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.modern: Take from among You a contribution to the LORD. Whoever is of a generous heart, let him bring the LORD's contribution: gold, silver, and bronze;

verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.modern: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine linen; goats' hair,

verses.kjv: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.modern: tanned rams' skins, and goatskins; acacia wood,

verses.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.modern: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,

verses.kjv: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.modern: onyx stones and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
verses.modern: Let every skillful craftsman among You come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

verses.kjv: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.modern: the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

verses.kjv: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.modern: the ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the veil of the screen;

verses.kjv: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.modern: the table with its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

verses.kjv: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.modern: the lampstand also for the light, with its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;

verses.kjv: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.modern: the altar of incense, with its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

verses.kjv: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.modern: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles. All its utensils, the basin and its stand;

verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.modern: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court;

verses.kjv: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.modern: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords,

verses.kjv: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.modern: the finely worked garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for their service as priests.'

verses.kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.modern: Then all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

verses.kjv: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.modern: they came, everyone whose heart stirred Him, and everyone whose spirit moved Him, and brought the LORD's contribution to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.

verses.kjv: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.modern: So they came, both men and women. All who were of a willing heart brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and armlets, all sorts of gold objects, every man dedicating an offering of gold to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
verses.modern: every one who possessed blue or purple or scarlet yarns or fine linen or goats' hair or tanned rams' skins or goatskins brought them.

verses.kjv: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.modern: Everyone who could make a contribution of silver or bronze brought it as the LORD's contribution. And every one who possessed acacia wood of any use in the work brought it.

verses.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.modern: every skillful woman spun with her hands. They all brought what they had spun in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
verses.modern: All the women whose hearts stirred them to use their skill spun the goats' hair.

verses.kjv: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.modern: the leaders brought onyx stones and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breastpiece,

verses.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.modern: spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

verses.kjv: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.modern: All the men and women, the children of Israel, whose heart moved them to bring anything for the work that the LORD had commanded by Moses to be done brought it as a freewill offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.modern: Then Moses said to the children of Israel, 'See, the LORD has called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

verses.kjv: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.modern: he has filled Him with the Spirit of God, with skill, with intelligence, with knowledge, and with all craftsmanship,

verses.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.modern: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold and silver and bronze,

verses.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.modern: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, for work in every skilled craft.

verses.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.modern: he has inspired Him to teach, both Him and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan.

verses.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.modern: He has filled them with skill to do every sort of work done by an engraver or by a designer or by an embroiderer in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, or by a weaver — by any sort of workman or skilled designer.

chapters.summary: Moses assembled the congregation and restated the command to keep the Sabbath, then called for a freewill offering of materials for the tabernacle — gold, silver, bronze, fabrics, skins, wood, oil, spices, and stones. The people brought willingly, and Moses identified Bezaleel and Aholiab as the craftsmen God had filled with his Spirit to design and build the tabernacle and all its furnishings.

verses.kjv: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
verses.modern: 'Bezaleel and Aholiab and every craftsman in whom the LORD has put skill and intelligence to know how to do any work in the construction of the sanctuary shall work in accordance with all that the LORD has commanded.'

verses.kjv: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.modern: Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab and every craftsman in whose heart the LORD had put skill, everyone whose heart stirred Him up to come to do the work.

verses.kjv: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
verses.modern: they received from Moses all the contribution that the children of Israel had brought for doing the work on the sanctuary. They still kept bringing him freewill offerings every morning,

verses.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
verses.modern: so that all the craftsmen who were doing every sort of task on the sanctuary came, each from the task that he was doing,

verses.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
verses.modern: said to Moses, 'The people bring much more than enough for doing the work that the LORD has commanded us to do.'

verses.kjv: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.modern: So Moses gave command, and word was proclaimed throughout the camp, 'Let no man or woman do anything more for the contribution for the sanctuary.' So the people were restrained from bringing,

verses.kjv: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.modern: for the material they had was sufficient to do all the work, and more.

verses.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
verses.modern: all the craftsmen among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains. They were made of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns, with cherubim skillfully worked.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
verses.modern: The length of each curtain was 28 cubits, and the breadth of each curtain 4 cubits. All the curtains were the same size.

verses.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
verses.modern: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

verses.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.modern: He made loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain of the first set. Likewise he made them on the edge of the outermost curtain of the second set.

verses.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.modern: He made fifty loops on the one curtain. He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set. The loops were opposite one another.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
verses.modern: he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to the other with clasps. So the tabernacle was a single whole.

verses.kjv: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.modern: He also made curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
verses.modern: The length of each curtain was 30 cubits, and the breadth of each curtain 4 cubits. The eleven curtains were the same size.

verses.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.modern: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.modern: he made fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain of the one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the other connecting curtain.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.modern: he made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together that it might be a single whole.

verses.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
verses.modern: he made for the tent a covering of tanned rams' skins and goatskins.

verses.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
verses.modern: Then he made the upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.

verses.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.modern: Ten cubits was the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each frame.

verses.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: Each frame had two tenons for fitting together. He did this for all the frames of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.modern: The frames for the tabernacle he made thus: twenty frames for the south side.

verses.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.modern: he made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons.

verses.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
verses.modern: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty frames

verses.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.modern: their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.

verses.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.modern: For the rear of the tabernacle westward he made six frames.

verses.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.modern: He made two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear.

verses.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
verses.modern: they were separate beneath but joined at the top, at the first ring. He made two of them this way for the two corners.

verses.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
verses.modern: There were eight frames with their bases of silver: sixteen bases, under every frame two bases.

verses.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.modern: He made bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
verses.modern: five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the tabernacle at the rear westward.

verses.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.modern: he made the middle bar to run from end to end halfway up the frames.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.modern: he overlaid the frames with gold, and made their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

verses.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
verses.modern: He made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen; with cherubim skillfully worked into it he made it.

verses.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.modern: for it he made four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast for them four bases of silver.

verses.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
verses.modern: He also made a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework,

verses.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
verses.modern: its five pillars with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold. Their five bases were of bronze.

chapters.summary: The craftsmen began building the tabernacle, and the people brought so much material that Moses had to command them to stop giving. The construction of the tabernacle's ten inner curtains of fine linen, the eleven curtains of goat hair, the coverings of ram skins and goatskins, and the boards of acacia wood with their silver sockets is described in detail, matching the pattern God had shown Moses on the mountain.

verses.kjv: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
verses.modern: Bezaleel made the ark of acacia wood. Two and a half cubits was its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.modern: he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold around it.

verses.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
verses.modern: he cast for it four rings of gold for its four feet, two rings on its one side and two rings on its other side.

verses.kjv: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.modern: he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold

verses.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.modern: put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

verses.kjv: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.modern: he made a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits was its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.

verses.kjv: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
verses.modern: he made two cherubim of gold. He made them of hammered work on the two ends of the mercy seat,

verses.kjv: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.modern: one cherub on the one end, and one cherub on the other end. Of one piece with the mercy seat he made the cherubim on its two ends.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
verses.modern: The cherubim spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.

verses.kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
verses.modern: He also made the table of acacia wood. Two cubits was its length, a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
verses.modern: he overlaid it with pure gold and made a molding of gold around it.

verses.kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
verses.modern: he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide, and made a molding of gold around the rim.

verses.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
verses.modern: He cast for it four rings of gold and fastened the rings to the four corners at its four legs.

verses.kjv: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.modern: Close to the frame were the rings, as holders for the poles to carry the table.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.modern: He made the poles of acacia wood to carry the table, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
verses.modern: he made the vessels of pure gold that were to be on the table, its plates and dishes for incense, and its bowls and flagons with which to pour drink offerings.

verses.kjv: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
verses.modern: He also made the lampstand of pure gold. He made the lampstand of hammered work. Its base, its stem, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

verses.kjv: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.modern: there were six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;

verses.kjv: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.modern: three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on the other branch — so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.

verses.kjv: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
verses.modern: on the lampstand itself were four cups made like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and flowers,

verses.kjv: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
verses.modern: a calyx of one piece with it under each pair of the six branches going out of it.

verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.modern: Their calyxes and their branches were of one piece with it, the whole of it a single piece of hammered work of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
verses.modern: he made its seven lamps and its tongs and its trays of pure gold.

verses.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.modern: He made it and all its utensils of a talent of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
verses.modern: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. Its length was a cubit, and its breadth was a cubit. It was square, and two cubits was its height. Its horns were of one piece with it.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.modern: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top and around its sides and its horns. And he made a molding of gold around it,

verses.kjv: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.modern: made two rings of gold on it under its molding, on two opposite sides of it, as holders for the poles with which to carry it.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.modern: he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
verses.modern: He made the holy anointing oil also, and the pure fragrant incense, blended as by the perfumer.

chapters.summary: Bezaleel constructed the ark of the covenant, overlaid it inside and out with pure gold, and made the mercy seat with two golden cherubim with wings spread above it. He also made the table of showbread with its dishes and utensils of pure gold, the seven-branched lampstand of beaten gold, and the altar of incense overlaid with gold, along with the holy anointing oil and the pure incense.

verses.kjv: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.modern: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. Five cubits was its length, and five cubits its breadth. It was square, and three cubits was its height.

verses.kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.modern: He made horns for it on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it. He overlaid it with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.modern: he made all the utensils of the altar, the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its utensils of bronze.

verses.kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
verses.modern: he made for the altar a grating, a network of bronze, under its ledge, extending halfway down.

verses.kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
verses.modern: He cast four rings on the four corners of the bronze grating as holders for the poles.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.modern: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.modern: he put the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar to carry it with them. He made it hollow, with boards.

verses.kjv: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: He made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze, from the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered in the entrance of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
verses.modern: he made the court. For the south side the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits;

verses.kjv: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.modern: their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.modern: for the north side there were hangings a hundred cubits; their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.modern: for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their ten pillars. Their ten bases; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.modern: for the front to the east, fifty cubits.

verses.kjv: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.modern: The hangings for the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.

verses.kjv: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.modern: so for the other side; on both sides of the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases.

verses.kjv: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.modern: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.modern: the bases for the pillars were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. The overlaying of their capitals was also of silver. All the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

verses.kjv: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.modern: the screen for the gate of the court was embroidered with needlework in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen. It was twenty cubits long and five cubits high in its breadth, corresponding to the hangings of the court.

verses.kjv: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
verses.modern: their pillars were four in number. Their four bases were of bronze, their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their fillets of silver.

verses.kjv: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.modern: all the pegs for the tabernacle and for the court all around were of bronze.

verses.kjv: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.modern: These are the records of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were recorded at the commandment of Moses, the responsibility of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Bezaleel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses;

verses.kjv: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.modern: with Him was Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and designer and embroiderer in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.modern: All the gold that was used for the work, in all the construction of the sanctuary, the gold from the offering, was twenty-nine talents and 730 shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.modern: The silver from those of the congregation who were numbered was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.kjv: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.modern: a beka a head (that is, half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary), for everyone who was numbered in the census, from twenty years old and upward, for 603,550 men.

verses.kjv: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.modern: The hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent a base.

verses.kjv: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.modern: of the 1,775 shekels He made hooks for the pillars and overlaid their capitals and made fillets for them.

verses.kjv: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.modern: The bronze that was offered was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels;

verses.kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.modern: with it He made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and the bronze grating for it and all the utensils of the altar,

verses.kjv: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.modern: the bases around the court, and the bases of the gate of the court, all the pegs of the tabernacle. All the pegs around the court.

chapters.summary: The bronze altar of burnt offering and the bronze basin were constructed, and the court of the tabernacle was set up with its pillars, hangings, and gate screen. An accounting of the materials used is given: the gold from the offering totaled twenty-nine talents and 730 shekels, the silver came from the atonement money of 603,550 men at a half-shekel each, and the bronze of the offering was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels.

verses.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: From the blue and purple and scarlet yarns they made finely woven garments, for ministering in the Holy Place. They made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.modern: He made the ephod of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
verses.modern: they hammered out gold leaf. He cut it into threads to work into the blue and purple and the scarlet yarns, and into the fine twined linen, in skilled design.

verses.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.modern: They made for the ephod attaching shoulder pieces, joined to it at its two edges.

verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: the skillfully woven band on it was of one piece with it and made like it, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: They made the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold filigree, and engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: he set them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod to be stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.modern: He made the breastpiece, in skilled work, in the style of the ephod, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
verses.modern: It was square. They made the breastpiece doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth when doubled.

verses.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
verses.modern: they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;

verses.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.modern: the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;

verses.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.modern: the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

verses.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.modern: the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in settings of gold filigree.

verses.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.modern: There were twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel. They were like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.

verses.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
