verses.modern: they made on the breastpiece twisted chains like cords, of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.modern: they made two settings of gold filigree and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.modern: they put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece.

verses.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.modern: They attached the two ends of the two cords to the two settings of filigree. Thus they attached it in front to the shoulder pieces of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.modern: Then they made two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.

verses.kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.modern: they made two rings of gold, and attached them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its seam above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it should lie on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece should not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.modern: He also made the robe of the ephod woven all of blue,

verses.kjv: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.modern: the opening of the robe in it was like the opening in a garment, with a binding around the opening, so that it might not tear.

verses.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.modern: On the hem of the robe they made pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.

verses.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.modern: They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates all around the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates —

verses.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate around the hem of the robe for ministering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.modern: They also made the coats, woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,

verses.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.modern: the turban of fine linen, and the caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twined linen,

verses.kjv: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: the sash of fine twined linen and of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, embroidered with needlework, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.modern: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engraving of a signet, Holy to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: they tied to it a cord of blue to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.modern: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished, and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they did.

verses.kjv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.modern: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its utensils, its hooks, its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;

verses.kjv: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.modern: the covering of tanned rams' skins and goatskins, and the veil of the screen;

verses.kjv: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.modern: the ark of the testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;

verses.kjv: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.modern: the table with all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

verses.kjv: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.modern: the lampstand of pure gold and its lamps with the lamps set. All its utensils, and the oil for the light;

verses.kjv: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.modern: the golden altar, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;

verses.kjv: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.modern: the bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles. All its utensils; the basin and its stand;

verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.modern: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs. All the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;

verses.kjv: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.modern: the finely worked garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons for their service as priests.

verses.kjv: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.modern: According to all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel had done all the work.

verses.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.modern: Moses saw all the work. They had done it; as the LORD had commanded, so had they done it. Then Moses blessed them.

chapters.summary: The priestly garments were made exactly as the LORD commanded: the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet; the breastplate set with twelve stones; the robe of the ephod with pomegranates and golden bells; the linen coats, the mitre with its golden plate reading "HOLINESS TO THE LORD," and the garments for Aaron's sons. All the work of the tabernacle was completed; the people brought everything to Moses, and he saw that they had done it as the LORD commanded, and Moses blessed them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses,

verses.kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.modern: 'On the first day of the first month You shall erect the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.modern: you shall put in it the ark of the testimony, and You shall screen the ark with the veil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.modern: you shall bring in the table and arrange it, and You shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.modern: you shall put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and set up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.modern: You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.modern: place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.modern: you shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen for the gate of the court.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.modern: Then You shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furniture, so that it may become holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.modern: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, so that the altar may become most holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.modern: You shall also anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.modern: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and shall wash them with water

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.modern: put on Aaron the holy garments. And you shall anoint him and consecrate him, that he may serve me as priest.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.modern: You shall bring his sons also and put coats on them,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.modern: anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall admit them to a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations.'

verses.kjv: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.modern: This Moses did; according to all that the LORD commanded Him, so He did.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.modern: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was erected.

verses.kjv: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.modern: Moses erected the tabernacle. He laid its bases, and set up its frames, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

verses.kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.modern: He took the testimony and put it into the ark, and put the poles on the ark and set the mercy seat above on the ark.

verses.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: he brought the ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.modern: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil,

verses.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.modern: arranged the bread on it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.modern: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.modern: He put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil,

verses.kjv: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: burned fragrant incense on it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: He also set up the screen for the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
verses.modern: He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing,

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.modern: with which Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.

verses.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.modern: he erected the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

verses.kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.modern: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.modern: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
verses.modern: Throughout all their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel would set out.

verses.kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.modern: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out till the day that it was taken up.

verses.kjv: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.modern: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.

chapters.summary: The LORD commanded Moses to set up the tabernacle on the first day of the first month; Moses erected the structure, placed the ark inside the most holy place, hung the veil, arranged the table, lampstand, and golden altar, and anointed everything with oil. He consecrated Aaron and his sons and set up the court around the tabernacle. When the work was finished, the cloud covered the tent of meeting and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle so that Moses could not enter; the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day and fire by night throughout all Israel's journeys.
